summary: xAI released Grok Imagine Video 1.5, an updated image-to-video model with faster generation, improved audio/motion realism, and new workflow features, now generally available via the Imagine API and Grok apps.

practices.reason: The model generates synchronized audio-video with fewer motion artifacts and nearly doubles generation speed, changing what is usable for interactive creative workflows.
practices.quote: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 Fast almost doubles generation speed: it produces 6-second, 720p videos in about 25 seconds, down from 40+ seconds in our previous model.

practices.reason: The model moves from preview to general availability under a new API model name, requiring teams to point integrations at the new endpoint.
practices.quote: Imagine Video 1.5 is out of preview and generally available in the xAI API as grok-imagine-video-1.5 .

practices.reason: The new multiple-agents feature lets users run several generation prompts in parallel, a workflow pattern worth watching but not detailed enough to implement generically.
practices.quote: Kick off multiple agents in parallel on your projects. Instead of waiting for one generation to finish before starting the next, you can run several prompts at once and let them work for you.
